title: Chubby Penguin with Scarf
description: A round, friendly penguin with a knotted scarf, belly patch and little flippers. Wide flat feet make it stand on its own.
use: Desk buddy, shelf figure, party favour or cake topper (use food-safe film if near food).
material: PLA, any colour. Print upright, 0.2 mm layers, 15% infill, no supports needed (small chin/scarf overhangs only).
